events.title: MSU Martyars' Trophy
events.snippet: The MSU Martyrs' Trophy 2026 provides a valuable platform for grassroots football, giving local players competitive match exposure on a quality turf ground. Beyond the sport itself, the tournament honors the memory of the community's martyrs and passes down important historical awareness to younger generations. By bringing together teams and supporters from across surrounding villages, it also strengthens community unity, promotes sportsmanship, and encourages positive, disciplined youth engagement.

events.title: Mass Rally Against the imposition of Vande mataram
events.snippet: On March 16, 2026, the Naga Students' Federation (NSF) held a mass rally to protest the compulsory singing of Vande Mataram in schools and official functions. The Mao Students' Union held its rally in support with the NSF initiative to opposed the mandate because it conflicts with the religious faith and conscience of the Naga people, undermines constitutional secularism and indigenous cultural rights, and was imposed without local consultation.

events.title: Mao Students' Union Scholarship
events.snippet:
The Mao Students' Union (MSU) awarded scholarships in November 2026 to selected students from 13 schools across the Mao area under its 1st Scholarship Programme, 2026, covering schools affiliated with the Mao Area Private Schools' Association (MAPSA).

Programme Highlights

• Scope: Covers students from 13 schools in the Mao area under MAPSA.
• Purpose: Supported by the MSU Executive Committee to recognize academic merit, provide financial assistance, raise awareness about scholarships, and encourage learning in the Mao community.
